record.one_liner: Plaid provides an API platform that connects bank accounts to applications for checking balances, transaction history, auth, and payments.

auth_methods.quote: Almost all Plaid API endpoints require a client_id and secret . These may be sent either in the request body or in the headers PLAID-CLIENT-ID and PLAID-SECRET .

access_test.quote: To gain access to the Plaid API, create an account on the Plaid Dashboard . Once you've completed the signup process and acknowledged our terms, we'll provide a live client_id and secret via the Dashboard.

access_ship.quote: Production Test or launch your app with unlimited live credentials

api_type.quote: The Plaid API is JSON over HTTP. Requests are POST requests, and responses are JSON

api_breadth.quote: API Reference Explore server-side API libraries and integrate with API endpoints View reference

official_mcp.quote: Plug me in via the Plaid MCP Server .
